To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the use of ANN-based models for the design of ORCs can be used to achieve globally optimal solutions, and that the use of such models is important for the optimal design of ORCs, since it leads to different design solutions in comparison to simplified thermodynamic properties, and thus to different economic performance.

the use of accurate thermodynamic models is crucial for the design of ORCs, which can be achieved by embedding ANN models into the process design problem, and that the choice of the network architecture has a significant impact on the optimization results and computational effort.
we have shown a way to integrate thermodynamic models in a global optimization framework for the process design of an ORCs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a methodology to accurately model the thermodynamic behaviour of fluids in process design optimization problems.

the following aspects: (i) The use of accurate thermodynamic models in process design, (ii) The use of ANNs to approximate thermodynamic properties in a reduced space and (iii) The influence of the ANN architecture on optimization results and performance.
the integration of accurate thermodynamics in process design optimization problems, and demonstrates the importance of this integration for the design of complex processes.

ANNs are a viable approach for the integration of accurate thermodynamics in global process optimization problems.
the use of ANNs for the design of process flowsheets is a promising approach.
the use of ANN-based thermodynamics is a promising approach to integrate accurate thermodynamics in global process design optimization problems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the use of ANN based surrogate models is a viable option for the design of process flowsheets with complex thermodynamics.
the use of ANNs for the integration of accurate thermodynamic models into process design is feasible.
the integration of accurate thermodynamic properties in process design optimization can be achieved by using ANNs and that the use of such accurate models can lead to different design decisions.

the use of accurate thermodynamic models is possible and can be done efficiently.
the use of ANNs is a powerful approach for the integration of complex, non-linear models in process design optimization.
